admission.justification: A starter request must not silently turn a read-and-report role into a code or memory writer, which would bypass the independent leaf owners.

applicability: Every Investigator assignment, including a later order from its starter.
conditions: Required code and memory changes are reported to their owning Worker or Curator.
exclusions: A separate order does not grant this role Worker or Curator authority.

evidence: test_role_instruction_wording.py clause and retirement probes; E9 unchanged inventories

statement: The Investigator edits no code checkout or leaf enclosure, memory or task state, starts no role and routes required code or memory changes to their owners.
